name: Arcane Archer
requirements: Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, and Weapon Focus (longbow or shortbow)

features.name: Enhance Arrows (Magic)
features.summary: Nonmagical arrows you fire become magical and gain a +1 enhancement bonus.

features.name: Imbue Arrow
features.summary: Place an area spell on an arrow and center its area where the arrow lands.

features.name: Existing Arcane Spellcasting +1
features.summary: Advance spells per day, spells known, and caster level in one existing arcane spellcasting class.

features.name: Enhance Arrows (Elemental)
features.summary: Choose flaming, frost, or shock for your nonmagical arrows after resting.

features.name: Existing Arcane Spellcasting +1
features.summary: Advance spells per day, spells known, and caster level in the chosen existing arcane spellcasting class.

features.name: Seeker Arrow
features.summary: Fire an arrow that bends around corners and ignores cover and concealment.

features.name: Existing Arcane Spellcasting +1
features.summary: Advance spells per day, spells known, and caster level in the chosen existing arcane spellcasting class.

features.name: Enhance Arrows (Distance)
features.summary: Your nonmagical arrows gain the distance weapon quality.

features.name: Phase Arrow
features.summary: Fire through nonmagical barriers and ignore cover, concealment, armor, and shield bonuses.

features.name: Existing Arcane Spellcasting +1
features.summary: Advance spells per day, spells known, and caster level in the chosen existing arcane spellcasting class.

features.name: Enhance Arrows (Elemental Burst)
features.summary: Replace the elemental quality with flaming burst, icy burst, or shocking burst.

features.name: Existing Arcane Spellcasting +1
features.summary: Advance spells per day, spells known, and caster level in the chosen existing arcane spellcasting class.

features.name: Hail of Arrows
features.summary: Once per day, fire one arrow at every target in range, up to your Arcane Archer level.

features.name: Existing Arcane Spellcasting +1
features.summary: Advance spells per day, spells known, and caster level in the chosen existing arcane spellcasting class.

features.name: Enhance Arrows (Aligned)
features.summary: Choose an alignment-compatible anarchic, axiomatic, holy, or unholy quality for your arrows.

features.name: Arrow of Death
features.summary: Create a slaying arrow whose damaged target must save against DC 20 + your Charisma modifier or die.

features.name: Existing Arcane Spellcasting +1
features.summary: Advance spells per day, spells known, and caster level in the chosen existing arcane spellcasting class.
